messages:
emma_ae: heads up  prospect LumenCare wants a private VPC pilot (on-prem fallback). Asking to remove the platform fee for the pilot and include Standard support. Theyre also asking for a short SLA and an option to convert to a 12mo committed contract after pilot. Can we get dealdesk + security involved?

leo_presales: notes from the call: they need customer-managed KMS (BYOK), audit events to their Splunk instance in JSON, and the option to run in an air-gapped mode later. Pilot load: steady 30rps, spikes to 150rps. They want a start date ~4 weeks out.

emma_ae: pricing ask is full platform fee waive for 90 days and a 50% discount on implementation services.

dana_dealdesk: we can consider a pilot credit but typically require either a signed intent-to-convert (non-binding) or a minimum future-commit threshold. What conversion ARR would make this economical?

karen_finance: suggest structure: pilot platform fee = $0 for 90 days (conditional) if they sign a Pilot Commitment Letter that includes either (1) 12mo commit at $150k ARR OR (2) commit to enter commercial negotiations with our standard SOW within 30d after pilot. If they decline both, apply a catch-up invoice equal to 60% of waived fees. Need to track revenue exposure.

tom_security: BYOK and audit forwarding ok but require completed security questionnaire + proof of SOC2 Type II. If they want HSM in an air-gapped env, that's a custom integration; estimate one-time engineering effort ~$10k plus $1k/mo ops surcharge. We'll need their KMS policy and a key escrow discussion if they request high-assurance rotation.

leo_presales: infra implications: for VPC private pilot wed need 8 worker GPUs, 2 control nodes, peering, and KMS routing. If they insist on air-gap for pilot, add 1 week to schedule.

emma_ae: customer pushback: they don't want to sign a binding 12mo right now. They asked for a softer condition: a conversion SLA (if KPI met) and a discount window.

dana_dealdesk: counter-proposal (draft concession):
- Pilot: 90 days private VPC
- Platform fee during pilot: $0 (credit applied)
- Implementation fee: 50% off for pilot setup (one-time)
- Support: Standard included for pilot (list $2,500/mo)
- Conversion options within 30 days post-pilot:
  A) 12mo commit: $150k ARR (equivalent to $12.5k/mo) => 20% off list for first year
  B) No commit: catch-up invoice = 60% of waived platform fees
- Minimum conversion ARR to permit pilot credit: $75k annualized
- Security gating: completed questionnaire + SOC2 artifacts + KMS policy review
- HSM/integration: estimated one-time integration fee $10k and recurring $1k/mo ops surcharge
- Legal: include clause allowing us to invoice catch-up if conversion not executed within window

dana_dealdesk: I'll file concession with code "VPC_PILOT_2026". Need finance and legal sign-off.

karen_finance: ok from finance if minimum ARR clause is present and catch-up % >=50%. I'll model exposure given their 70% conversion probability.

tom_security: Ill send the questionnaire link to their SecOps right now and flag the HSM costs.

deploy-bot: infra-plan: lumencare-pilot => estimated: 8 GPUs, 2 control-plane, vpc peering, k8s cluster, kms-route. ETA 21 days after sign-off.

leo_presales: action items: (1) @dana_dealdesk submit concession with the draft above; (2) @tom_security send questionnaire + HSM cost note; (3) @deploy-bot owners confirm ETA and minimal runbook; (4) @karen_finance confirm modeling numbers in concession.

emma_ae: I'll ask customer for a signed Pilot Commitment Letter (non-binding conversion preference) and legal contact. Also to confirm start date. :thumbsup:

dana_dealdesk: drafting and routing now. Will ping for approvals by COB.

karen_finance: will review P&L impact once concession draft is attached.

leo_presales: I'll prepare a minimal syslog->Splunk config snippet and a KMS BYOK checklist to attach.

emma_ae: thanks all  let's aim to have concession approved within 48 hours so we don't miss their window.
